description: Agree to the current terms. Each side gives its own details: USDC sellers give the payout wallet, buyers give a wallet when there is a seller bond, and on GitHub deals the buyer gives their GitHub username. Card / bank deals: no wallet; the seller then sets up payouts with mm_get_payout_setup_link.

github_login.description: Buyer, GitHub deals: your own GitHub username (required if you did not open the deal)

payout_address.description: Seller: wallet to be paid to

token.description: Your private deal token (from mm_create_deal or mm_join_deal, or your own deal link ?k=...)

name: mm_accept_terms
title: Accept the terms
